decisions.decision: scripts/10-upload-r2.mjs: an explicit --date now always overrides the Phase-6 RANGES guard, so one-off posts outside the two Phase-6 date ranges can still be uploaded by name.
decisions.rationale: The 2022-06-22/23 gap-day stubs are legitimate site content but fall outside both Phase-6 in-scope ranges; the script previously silently processed 0 posts for them even with --date specified, which looked like success but did nothing.

decisions.decision: A no-movement multi-day stay recap post should have no miles/hours frontmatter at all (VoyageStats renders nothing when all its props are undefined), matching the pre-existing convention already used by 'Guests of a Private Island Club'.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed while fixing 'A Week in the Big City' -- showing travel distance/speed on a day with zero boat movement is actively misleading, and the project already had an established correct pattern for this exact case.

decisions.decision: When two posts share the same frontmatter `date`, they silently share one NeboMap + one nebo-day-stats.json lookup (both keyed by that single date) -- this is the general mechanism behind every 'wrong map shown' complaint so far, not a one-off bug. Any future report of a wrong/duplicate map should start by checking for a date collision with another real post.
decisions.rationale: Confirmed directly in BlogPost.astro: `dateKey = date.toISOString().slice(0,10)` drives both `neboMaps[dateKey]` and `neboDayStats[dateKey]`, with no per-post override.
